configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day (First Line)
configurationFields.description: Sets the first line of the message of the day (MOTD) displayed when players join. [Colour codes](https://etconfig.net/et-color-codes/et-color-codes/) can be used

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day (Second Line)
configurationFields.description: Sets the second line of the MOTD. [Colour codes](https://etconfig.net/et-color-codes/et-color-codes/) can be used. Up to four additional lines can be specified under Additional Server Settings, for example: set server_motd2 "third line"

configurationFields.label: Enable Internet Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will start as an internet server. Otherwise it will start as a LAN server

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Private Client Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for private clients, if any, to connect to the server. Specify the required number of private clients under Private Client Number

configurationFields.label: Referee Status Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the referee status password. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If set, only unmodified pak files that are also installed on the server can be used by clients, as a hacking and cheat protection

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the map rotation mode. Configure the relevant script for that rotation mode accordingly in the relevant "AMP_" cycle.cfg file in etmain

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time, including private clients

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players that must join the server before a round can start

configurationFields.label: Private Client Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of slots (out of the Player Limit) reserved for private players on a public server. 0 = disabled. Private Client Password must also be set

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server And Web
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, models, etc) from either the server or the web

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Web
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, models, etc) from the web

configurationFields.label: Base Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the base URL for download redirection

configurationFields.label: Fallback Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL to send to if an http/ftp fails or is refused client side

configurationFields.label: Download While Disconnected
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be told to perform their downloads while disconnected from the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum Server Download Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that the server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Server Memory Allocation
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of memory allocated for players and items

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable bandwidth a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Antilag
configurationFields.description: If set, antilag will be enabled, which is better for high ping players

configurationFields.label: Enable Punkbuster
configurationFields.description: If set, the Punkbuster anti-cheat system will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Watchdog Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval for the Watchdog to check whether for the game dying with an ERR_DROP or any situation leading to the server running with no map

configurationFields.label: Watchdog Command
configurationFields.description: Sets the console variable to action in the event of a Watchdog trigger. Empty = quit (default)

configurationFields.label: Logging Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the mode for logging to etmain/etserver.log

options.2: Enable logging that is flushed after each print

configurationFields.label: Enable Synced Console Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, the writing of server logs will be synchronised rather than buffered

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the binding of the server and RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: The IP must be reachable by GSCS, otherwise GSCS's console won't work

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in "etmain/server.cfg" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, friendly fire will be allowed, so players can damage their own teammates

configurationFields.label: Heavy Weapons Restriction
configurationFields.description: Restricts heavy weapons to the set percentage of the team

configurationFields.label: Enable Forced Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: If set, a new player will be forced onto the smallest or losing team. Otherwise, the player can select freely which team to join

configurationFields.label: Disable Team Switching
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be prevented from switching teams

configurationFields.label: Enable Alternate Stopwatch Mode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the stopwatch mode format will be A-B-A-B instead of A-B-B-A

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Fireteams
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be automatically put into fireteams

configurationFields.label: Complaint Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of complaints after which a player will be kicked

configurationFields.label: IP Complaint Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of IPs (different players) from which complaints are filed, after which a player will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, player will be instantly active after being revived

configurationFields.label: Maximum Lives For Allied Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of lives each Allied player has individually. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Maximum Lives For Axis Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of lives each Axis player has individually. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Allowed Voice Chats
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of voice chats allowed within 30 seconds per player

configurationFields.label: Enable Flood Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be protected from being flooded by players via chat

configurationFields.label: Enable Warmup
configurationFields.description: If set, the warmup period will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Player Warmup Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of warmup time allotted to connected clients, assuming warmup is enabled

configurationFields.label: Spectator Inactivity Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time a spectator can remain idle before being kicked from the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Late Joining
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be allowed to join a match in progress

configurationFields.label: Mute Spectators
configurationFields.description: If enabled, spectators will be muted

configurationFields.label: Ready Percentage To Start Round
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of players required to have set ready before a round will commence

configurationFields.label: Timeout Count Per Team
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of times non-referee players on each team can pause the match

configurationFields.label: Enable Warmup Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire during the warmup period will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Players Per Team
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that can join each team. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Team Controls
configurationFields.description: If set, players will not have team controls, such as '/readyteam'

configurationFields.label: Enable Fixed Rate Game Physics
configurationFields.description: If set, the function responsible for game physics will be run at a fixed rate, as set under Game Physics Fixed Rate, to level the playing field

configurationFields.label: Game Physics Fixed Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the fixed rate for the game physics function. Requires Enable Fixed Rate Game Physics to be set

configurationFields.label: LMS: Follow Team Only
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be restricted to only being able to spectate their teammates in Last Man Standing (LMS)

configurationFields.label: LMS: Lock Teams
configurationFields.description: If set, both teams will be locked when the warmup period is done and a match is started in Last Man Standing (LMS)

configurationFields.label: LMS: Match Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of matches to be played in Last Man Standing (LMS) before moving to the next map

configurationFields.label: LMS: Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of rounds to be played in Last Man Standing (LMS) to determine a team as the winner or a draw to finish a match. The winner is the first to reach (round limit / 2) + 1

configurationFields.label: LMS: Enable Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: If set, team balancing will be enabled in Last Man Standing (LMS) matches

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting
configurationFields.description: If set, connected players can call for and vote on changes permitted by the other settings in this menu, or otherwise as set in Additional Server Settings

configurationFields.label: Maximum Votes Per Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of votes allowed per map

configurationFields.label: Vote Approval Percentage
configurationFields.description: Sets the required percentage of all players needed to vote 'yes' for a vote to pass

configurationFields.label: Allow Comp Settings Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to load 'comp' settings will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Gametype Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to change the gametype will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Kick Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to kick players will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Map Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to change the map will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Match Reset Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to reset a match will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Mute Spectators Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to mute spectators will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Next Map Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to skip to the next map in the rotation configuration will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Pub Settings Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to load 'pub' settings will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Referee Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to assign someone as referee will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Shuffle Teams Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to shuffle teams will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Swap Teams Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to swap teams will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Friendly Fire Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to toggle the friendly fire setting will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Time Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to change the map time limit will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Warmup Damage Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to toggle the warmup damage setting will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Antilag Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to toggle the antilag setting will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Balanced Teams Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to toggle the balanced team requirement will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Muting Vote
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting to mute individual players will be allowed

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
